```{r}
# ==== 0) Load Required Packages ====
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
need <- c("MOFA2", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "pheatmap", "matrixStats", "readr", "tibble")
inst <- need[!need %in% installed.packages()[,1]]
if (length(inst)) BiocManager::install(inst, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)

# Load libraries without startup messages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(MOFA2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})


```



```{r}
# ==== 1) Define Directory Paths ====
source("R/workflow_utils.R")
cfg <- load_moda_paths()
base_dir <- cfg$external_project_dir

# Define subdirectories
proc_dir <- cfg$external_processed_dir
results_root <- if (nzchar(cfg$external_results_dir)) cfg$external_results_dir else file.path(base_dir, "results")

# Create results directories if not already existing
res_fig <- file.path(results_root, "figures");     dir.create(res_fig,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
res_tab <- file.path(results_root, "tables");      dir.create(res_tab,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
res_sig <- file.path(results_root, "signatures");  dir.create(res_sig, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


```



```{r}
# ==== 2) Load Scaled Matrices and Metadata ====
rna  <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "rna", "scaled.rds"))
prot <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "proteome", "scaled.rds"))
ph   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "phospho", "scaled.rds"))
meth <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "methyl", "scaled.rds"))
mir  <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "mirna", "scaled.rds"))
ac   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "acetyl", "scaled.rds"))

meta <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "meta_labels.rds"))

# Ensure the same sample order across all datasets
all_cols <- list(
  colnames(rna),
  colnames(prot),
  colnames(ph),
  colnames(meth),
  colnames(mir),
  colnames(ac)
)

common <- Reduce(intersect, all_cols)
stopifnot(length(common) >= 250)

# Reorder columns to match the common set
reorder <- function(m) m[, common, drop = FALSE]
rna <- reorder(rna)
prot <- reorder(prot)
ph <- reorder(ph)
meth <- reorder(meth)
mir <- reorder(mir)
ac <- reorder(ac)
```



# ==== 4) Build MOFA object ====


```{r}
# ==== 3) Configure Python Environment for MOFA+ ====
library(MOFA2)
library(reticulate)

# Display current Python configuration
py_config()

# Optional: allow an explicit Python interpreter via environment variable
python_bin <- Sys.getenv("MODA_PYTHON", unset = "")
if (nzchar(python_bin)) {
  use_python(python_bin, required = TRUE)
}

# Verify that the 'mofapy2' Python module is available
stopifnot(py_module_available("mofapy2"))

```

```{r}
# ---- Data Options ----
data_opts <- get_default_data_options(MOFAobject)
data_opts

# ---- Model Options ----
model_opts <- get_default_model_options(MOFAobject)
model_opts$num_factors <- 15  # Set the number of latent factors
model_opts

# ---- Training Options ----
train_opts <- get_default_training_options(MOFAobject)
train_opts$convergence_mode <- "slow"  # Use slow convergence mode for better accuracy
train_opts$seed <- 42                  # Set seed for reproducibility
train_opts

# ---- Prepare MOFA Object for Training ----
MOFAobject <- prepare_mofa(
  MOFAobject,
  data_options = data_opts,
  model_options = model_opts,
  training_options = train_opts
)

```

```{r}
# ==== 7) Load and Clean Clinical Metadata ====
out_dir <- proc_dir

# Load clinical metadata file
clinical_imp <- read_tsv(file.path(out_dir, "clinical_clean.tsv"))

# Copy data and rename the sample ID column
meta_orig <- clinical_imp
meta_orig <- meta_orig %>% rename(sample = sample_id)

# Temporarily store the first column (for rownames assignment)
rownames_tmp <- meta_orig[[1]]

# Remove the first column if needed
# meta_orig <- meta_orig[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# Assign row names based on the first column
rownames(meta_orig) <- rownames_tmp

# Remove dots from row names
rownames(meta_orig) <- gsub("\\.", "", rownames(meta_orig))  # Removes dots

# Add sample column explicitly
meta_orig$sample <- rownames(meta_orig)

# Ensure row names match the sample column
rownames(meta_orig) <- meta_orig[[1]]

# Recode EGFR mutation information into grouped categories
meta_orig$egfr_mutation_info <- ifelse(
  meta_orig$egfr_mutation_info %in% c("Exon21.Leu858Arg", "Exon19.Deletion", "Other"),
  "Mutation",
  meta_orig$egfr_mutation_info
)


```

```{r}
# ==== 9) Extract Top Features per Factor from MOFA+ Model ====

library(MOFA2)
library(dplyr)

# Select factors of interest (F1: Smoking/TMB, F3: EGFR/Overall Survival)
sel_factors <- c(1, 3)

# ---- RNA ----
w_rna <- get_weights(model, views = "RNA", factors = sel_factors, as.data.frame = TRUE)
top_rna <- w_rna %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(value), n = 200) %>%
  pull(feature) %>%
  unique()

# ---- miRNA (if available) ----
w_mir <- get_weights(model, views = "miRNA", factors = sel_factors, as.data.frame = TRUE)
top_mir <- w_mir %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(value), n = 50) %>%
  pull(feature) %>%
  unique()

# ---- Methylation (useful for EGFR/methylation-related analysis) ----
w_meth <- get_weights(model, views = "Methyl", factors = c(2, 3), as.data.frame = TRUE)
top_meth <- w_meth %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(value), n = 200) %>%
  pull(feature) %>%
  unique()

```



```{r}
# ==== 10) Extract Top Features from Multiple Views (Robust Function) ====

library(MOFA2)
library(dplyr)

# Get available view names (compatible with all MOFA2 versions)
views_avail <- tryCatch(
  views_names(model),
  error = function(e) names(feature_names(model))
)
print(views_avail)
# Expected output: "RNA" "Proteome" "Phospho" "Methyl" "miRNA" "Acetyl"

# Define a robust function to extract top features from any view for selected factors
get_top <- function(model, view, factors, n = 200) {
  # Assume the view name is valid; if not, print a helpful message
  W <- try(
    get_weights(model, views = view, factors = factors, as.data.frame = TRUE),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(W, "try-error") || is.null(W) || nrow(W) == 0) {
    message("Skipping view '", view, "' (not found or empty).")
    return(character(0))
  }
  
  W %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarise(score = sum(abs(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(order_by = score, n = n) %>%
    pull(feature) %>%
    unique()
}

# ---- Example Usage (Based on Analysis Plan) ----
top_rna_F1   <- get_top(model, "RNA",    factors = 1,      n = 200)
top_mir_F1   <- get_top(model, "miRNA",  factors = 1,      n = 50)
top_rna_F3   <- get_top(model, "RNA",    factors = 3,      n = 200)
top_meth_F23 <- get_top(model, "Methyl", factors = c(2, 3), n = 200)

# Display the number of top features retrieved from each view
length(top_rna_F1)
length(top_mir_F1)
length(top_rna_F3)
length(top_meth_F23)



```

```{r}
# ==== 13) Statistical Analysis and Visualization of Factors by EGFR Status ====

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(effectsize)  # For computing Cohen's d effect size

# ---- Compute effect sizes and central tendency differences for each factor ----
es_tab <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  summarise(
    median_No = median(value[egfr_mutation_info == "No.Mutation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Mut = median(value[egfr_mutation_info == "Mutation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_No = mean(value[egfr_mutation_info == "No.Mutation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Mut = mean(value[egfr_mutation_info == "Mutation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_No = sum(egfr_mutation_info == "No.Mutation"),
    n_Mut = sum(egfr_mutation_info == "Mutation"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    median_diff = median_Mut - median_No,
    mean_diff = mean_Mut - mean_No,
    cohen_d = tryCatch(
      cohens_d(value ~ egfr_mutation_info, data = df_plot %>% filter(factor == factor))$Cohens_d,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  )

# ---- Merge p-values with effect size table ----
annot <- pv_tab %>% left_join(es_tab, by = "factor")

# ---- Create violin and box plots for each factor ----
p2 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = egfr_mutation_info, y = value, fill = egfr_mutation_info)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, width = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor, scales = "fixed", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "EGFR mutation",
    y = "Factor value",
    title = "Violin plots of significant Factors by EGFR status"
  )

# ---- Add statistical annotations (p, FDR, median difference, Cohen's d) ----
pos <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(factor) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(annot, by = "factor") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "p=", ifelse(p_wilcox < 1e-4, "<1e-4", signif(p_wilcox, 3)),
      "\nFDR=", signif(FDR_wilcox, 3),
      "\ndMedian=", round(median_diff, 3),
      "\nCohenD=", round(cohen_d, 2)
    ),
    y = ymax + 0.12 * (abs(ymax) + 1)
  )

p2 + geom_text(data = pos, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3)


```






```{r}
# ==== 14) Extract Factors from MOFA+ Model and Perform Statistical Tests ====

# Extract all factors from the trained model
factors_all <- get_factors(model, as.data.frame = TRUE)

# Preview the factor table (expected columns: sample, factor, value, group)
head(factors_all)

library(tidyr)

# ---- Reshape factors into a wide format (one column per factor) ----
df_factors <- factors_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = factor, values_from = value)

df <- df_factors

# ---- Add clinical variables (EGFR status, TMB, smoking score) ----
df$EGFR_simple <- ifelse(
  meta_orig[df$sample, "egfr_mutation_info"] == "No.Mutation",
  "No.Mutation",
  "Mutation"
)

df$tmb <- as.numeric(meta_orig[df$sample, "tmb"])
df$smoking <- as.numeric(meta_orig[df$sample, "smoking_score"])

# ---- Statistical Tests ----

# Compare Factor 1 and Factor 3 values between EGFR mutation groups
wilcox.test(df$Factor1 ~ df$EGFR_simple)
wilcox.test(df$Factor3 ~ df$EGFR_simple)

# Correlation between factors and TMB
cor.test(df$Factor1, df$tmb, method = "spearman")
cor.test(df$Factor3, df$tmb, method = "spearman")

# Correlation between factors and smoking score
cor.test(df$Factor1, df$smoking, method = "spearman")
cor.test(df$Factor3, df$smoking, method = "spearman")


```

```{r}
  group_by(EGFR_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    F1_med = median(Factor1),
    F3_med = median(Factor3),
    TMB_med = median(tmb, na.rm = TRUE),
    smoke_med = median(smoking, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---- Compute effect sizes (Cliff’s Delta) for EGFR mutation separation ----
cliff.delta(Factor1 ~ EGFR_simple, data = df)
cliff.delta(Factor3 ~ EGFR_simple, data = df)
```

```{r}
# ==== 16) Logistic Regression and Feature Weight Exploration ====

# ---- Encode EGFR mutation as a binary variable ----
df$EGFR_bin <- ifelse(df$EGFR_simple == "Mutation", 1, 0)

# ---- Logistic regression: Predict EGFR mutation using Factor3, TMB, and smoking ----
fit1 <- glm(EGFR_bin ~ Factor3 + log10(tmb + 1) + smoking, data = df, family = binomial)
summary(fit1)

# ---- Compute AUC for model performance ----
library(pROC)
auc1 <- roc(df$EGFR_bin, fitted(fit1))
auc1$auc

# ---- Correlation between Factor1 and TMB within EGFR subgroups ----
by(
  df, df$EGFR_simple,
  function(d) cor.test(d$Factor1, d$tmb, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
)
```

```{r}
# ==== 19) Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) Preparation ====

library(MOFA2)
# library(reactomeGS)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

```



```{r}

# ==== 26) GSEA Mapping and Gene Annotation ====

library(MOFA2)
library(dplyr)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# ---- Extract RNA gene symbols from the MOFA object ----
sym_raw <- features_names(MOFAobject)[["RNA"]]

# Clean gene symbols (remove "_RNA" suffix and extra spaces)
sym_clean <- sub("_RNA$", "", trimws(sym_raw))

# ---- Map SYMBOL → ENSEMBL ----
m1 <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = unique(sym_clean),
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  columns = "ENSEMBL"
)
m1 <- m1[!is.na(m1$ENSEMBL), c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")]
m1 <- m1[!duplicated(m1$SYMBOL), ]

# ---- Map unresolved genes via ALIAS ----
missing <- setdiff(unique(sym_clean), m1$SYMBOL)
m2 <- if (length(missing)) {
  tmp <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = missing,
    keytype = "ALIAS",
    columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")
  )
  tmp <- tmp[!is.na(tmp$ENSEMBL) & !is.na(tmp$SYMBOL), ]
  tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$ALIAS), c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")]
  tmp <- tmp[!tmp$SYMBOL %in% m1$SYMBOL, ]
  tmp
} else data.frame(SYMBOL = character(), ENSEMBL = character())

map <- rbind(m1, m2)

# ---- Build mapping vector ----
sym2ens <- setNames(map$ENSEMBL, map$SYMBOL)
ens_vec <- unname(sym2ens[sym_clean])

# For unmapped genes, keep them as "SYMBOL:<GENE>" for clarity
na_idx <- is.na(ens_vec)
ens_vec[na_idx] <- paste0("SYMBOL:", sym_clean[na_idx])

# Ensure unique names
ens_vec <- make.unique(ens_vec)

# Coverage report
n_total <- length(sym_clean)
n_map <- sum(!na_idx)
cat("Mapped to Ensembl:", round(100 * n_map / n_total, 1), "%\n")
# Example output: Mapped to Ensembl: 97.8 %

```

```{r}
# ==== 20) Update MOFA Object with Ensembl Gene IDs ====

# 0) Create a working copy of the MOFA object
MOFA_ens <- mofa

# 1) Retrieve current RNA feature names
sym_now <- features_names(MOFA_ens)[["RNA"]]

# 2) Clean and fix Ensembl vector
ens_fix <- ens_vec
bad <- is.na(ens_fix) | ens_fix == ""
ens_fix[bad] <- paste0("UNK__", sym_now[bad])

# Make all names unique in case of duplicates
if (any(duplicated(ens_fix))) {
  dups <- which(duplicated(ens_fix))
  ens_fix[dups] <- paste0(ens_fix[dups], "_", ave(ens_fix[dups], ens_fix[dups], FUN = seq_along))
}

# 3) Apply the updated feature names to the MOFA object
fn <- features_names(MOFA_ens)
stopifnot(length(fn[["RNA"]]) == length(ens_fix))
fn[["RNA"]] <- ens_fix
features_names(MOFA_ens) <- fn

# 4) Align row names of RNA weights with updated Ensembl IDs
rownames(MOFA_ens@expectations$W$RNA) <- ens_fix

# ---- Confirmation ----
features_names(MOFA_ens)[["RNA"]][1:5]
rownames(MOFA_ens@expectations$W$RNA)[1:5]
```

```{r}
# ==== MOFA Biomarker Extraction Pipeline ====

# ---- Load Required Packages ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(MOFA2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(stringr); library(purrr); library(ggplot2)
})

# ---- 1) User Settings ----
obj <- if (exists("MOFA_ens")) MOFA_ens else model  # Use MOFA_ens if available (Ensembl), otherwise use model
factors_of_interest <- c(1, 3)                      # Main factors of interest
top_n <- c(RNA = 200, miRNA = 100, Proteome = 150, Methyl = 200, Phospho = 150, Acetyl = 150)
z_thresh <- 2.0                                     # Z-score selection threshold
outdir <- "MOFA_biomarkers"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- 2) Extract Weights and Compute Rankings and Robust Z-scores ----
wdf <- get_weights(obj, views = "all", factors = factors_of_interest, as.data.frame = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(view, factor) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_weight = abs(value),
    z = (value - median(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / mad(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    rank_abs = row_number(desc(abs_weight)),
    feature_clean = case_when(
      view == "RNA" ~ str_remove(as.character(feature), "_RNA$"),
      TRUE ~ as.character(feature)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- 3) Select Top-N Features per View (Default = 100 if Missing) ----
top_tbl <- tibble(view = names(top_n), topN = as.integer(top_n))
wdf <- wdf %>% left_join(top_tbl, by = "view") %>%
  mutate(topN = ifelse(is.na(topN), 100L, topN))

top_byN <- wdf %>%
  group_by(view, factor) %>%
  filter(rank_abs <= topN) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(selection = "topN")

# ---- 4) Additional Selection by Z-score ----
top_byZ <- wdf %>% filter(abs(z) >= z_thresh) %>% mutate(selection = paste0("z>=", z_thresh))

biomarkers <- bind_rows(top_byN, top_byZ) %>%
  distinct(view, factor, feature, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- 5) Determine Expression Direction (Up in EGFR Mutation vs No.Mutation) ----
if (exists("meta_orig") && "egfr_mutation_info" %in% colnames(meta_orig)) {
  # Simplify EGFR mutation categories
  egfr_simple_vec <- setNames(
    ifelse(meta_orig$egfr_mutation_info == "No.Mutation", "No.Mutation", "Mutation"),
    rownames(meta_orig)
  )
  
  # Retrieve factor values
  f_long <- get_factors(obj, as.data.frame = TRUE)
  f_long$EGFR_simple <- egfr_simple_vec[f_long$sample]
  
  dir_map <- f_long %>%
    filter(factor %in% paste0("Factor", factors_of_interest)) %>%
    group_by(factor, EGFR_simple) %>%
    summarise(med = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = EGFR_simple, values_from = med) %>%
    mutate(sign_map = ifelse(Mutation > `No.Mutation`, +1, -1)) %>%
    select(factor, sign_map)
  
  biomarkers <- biomarkers %>%
    left_join(dir_map, by = "factor") %>%
    mutate(direction = case_when(
      !is.na(sign_map) & value * sign_map > 0 ~ "Up in EGFR Mutation",
      !is.na(sign_map) & value * sign_map < 0 ~ "Up in No.Mutation",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
}

# ---- 6) Save Tables (Combined + Per Factor/View) and Gene Lists for DIABLO ----
write_tsv(
  biomarkers %>% arrange(factor, view, rank_abs),
  file.path(outdir, "MOFA_biomarkers_combined.tsv")
)

split(biomarkers, list(biomarkers$factor, biomarkers$view), drop = TRUE) %>%
  imap(function(df, key) {
    fn <- paste0("biomarkers_", key[[1]], "_", key[[2]], ".tsv")
    write_tsv(df %>% arrange(rank_abs), file.path(outdir, fn))
  })

# Export plain-text gene lists for DIABLO
gl_dir <- file.path(outdir, "gene_lists_for_DIABLO")
dir.create(gl_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

biomarkers %>%
  group_by(factor, view) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(feature_clean)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pwalk(function(factor, view, genes) {
    writeLines(sort(genes), file.path(gl_dir, paste0("genes_", factor, "_", view, ".txt")))
  })

# ---- 7) Consensus Features (Shared Between Factor1 and Factor3 per View) ----
consensus <- biomarkers %>%
  filter(factor %in% paste0("Factor", factors_of_interest)) %>%
  group_by(view, feature_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    factors = paste(sort(unique(factor)), collapse = ","),
    n_factors = n_distinct(factor),
    any_up_mut = any(direction == "Up in EGFR Mutation", na.rm = TRUE),
    any_up_no  = any(direction == "Up in No.Mutation", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_factors >= 2)

write_tsv(consensus, file.path(outdir, "consensus_biomarkers_F1_F3_by_view.tsv"))

# ---- 8) Quick Summary Plot: Feature Counts per View/Factor ----
counts <- biomarkers %>% count(factor, view)
p <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = reorder(view, n), y = n, fill = view)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + facet_wrap(~factor, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "View", y = "#Selected features", title = "Selected MOFA biomarkers per view/factor") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "counts_per_view_per_factor.pdf"), p, width = 9, height = 5)

# ==== Output Summary ====
# - MOFA_biomarkers/MOFA_biomarkers_combined.tsv          (Full biomarker table)
# - MOFA_biomarkers/biomarkers_FactorX_ViewY.tsv          (Per-factor/view files)
# - MOFA_biomarkers/gene_lists_for_DIABLO/*.txt           (Plain gene lists for DIABLO)
# - MOFA_biomarkers/consensus_biomarkers_F1_F3_by_view.tsv (Shared features between F1 and F3)
# - MOFA_biomarkers/counts_per_view_per_factor.pdf        (Visualization summary)

```
